paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the tradeoff between IDK recall and IDK error rate for four different parameter configurations, with each data point annotated by its corresponding IDK recall value. The x-axis represents the IDK error rate, plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.25, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis represents IDK recall, also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The blue solid line with 'x' markers, labeled "No ℒ_FP-reg: fixed λ", starts at an IDK error rate of 0.05 with an IDK recall of 0.1 and ends at an IDK error rate of 0.25 with an IDK recall of 0.5. The orange solid line with 'x' markers, labeled "With ℒ_FP-reg: fixed λ", begins at an IDK error rate of 0.05 with an IDK recall of 0.1 and ends at an IDK error rate of 0.25 with an IDK recall of 0.5. The green dashed line with triangle markers, labeled "No ℒ_FP-reg: adaptive λ", starts at an IDK error rate of 0.05 with an IDK recall of 0.2 and ends at an IDK error rate of 0.25 with an IDK recall of 0.5. The red dashed line with triangle markers, labeled "With ℒ_FP-reg: adaptive λ", begins at an IDK error rate of 0.05 with an IDK recall of 0.2 and ends at an IDK error rate of 0.25 with an IDK recall of 0.5.
